reviews.text:
Mauricio and his company Mr. Remodeling are excellent to work with and we have used them on multiple occasions to remodel two bathrooms and a kitchen. His communication is great and he can play as big or small a roll in your remodel design as you want.  He has great suggestions on ways to do things and can find creative ways to make your dream design come true.

He was also much quicker than other contractors we’ve used to remodel other things prior to finding Mr. Remodeling. On the most recent

Mauricio and his team have been lifesavers! I had a totally disastrous experience with another contractor which resulted in my remodeling project being left incomplete and/or shoddily done after 6 months. Mauricio and his time came to our rescue. He gave me a bid which was acceptable under the circumstances. He and his team were here on the days they said they would be here and were timely. They were efficient and NEVER left me with a mess to cleanup.  The difference in their work ethics and per

Mauricio is exceptional as a competent contractor who makes certain his clients understand the work to be done including a reasoned time frame with excellent communication. He listens and responds so that agreement is reached as to what’s been said and next steps in the construction process. Finally, I was deeply impressed with his teams daily clean up both inside and outside the home.

Thank you for a job well done😇

From the start of our major first floor remodel including kitchen we’ve been so absolutely pleased! Mauricio and his team, which we give high praises to, nailed our project and in a timely manner. Our kitchen, new stairs and living room look like a new house! He even came up with a design to cover & make a white beam across our downstairs look like a wooden beam for this 20’ ceiling. We absolutely recommend him!  And thank you Mauricio!!!!

reviews.text:
Mauricio and his company Mr. Remodeling are excellent to work with and we have used them on multiple occasions to remodel two bathrooms and a kitchen. His communication is great and he can play as big or small a roll in your remodel design as you want.  He has great suggestions on ways to do things and can find creative ways to make your dream design come true.

He was also much quicker than other contractors we’ve used to remodel other things prior to finding Mr. Remodeling. On the most recent bathroom he did for us he took half as long as a previous company that did our other bathroom, even though the bathroom was twice the size! I highly recommend Mauricio and his team!
reviews.author: Drew Brenner

reviews.text:
Mauricio and his team have been lifesavers! I had a totally disastrous experience with another contractor which resulted in my remodeling project being left incomplete and/or shoddily done after 6 months. Mauricio and his time came to our rescue. He gave me a bid which was acceptable under the circumstances. He and his team were here on the days they said they would be here and were timely. They were efficient and NEVER left me with a mess to cleanup.  The difference in their work ethics and performance was amazing. I was very leery, but they put me at ease very quickly by demonstrating their professionalism.

Mauricio proved to be very meticulous about the end results. The shower remodel was the most challenging because of the poor quality and incomplete job of the previous contractor. Mauricio worked diligently and was able to salvage the shower so that the flaws from previous contractor are not so obvious. He even had the custom shower glass door redone because he was not satisfied with the results of the first one. The second one is beautifully done, and the installation was perfect. Just to give other examples, Mauricio and his team reinstalled a built-in microwave with a beautiful stainless-steel trim that was poorly done and also redid a bathtub restoration that had already begun to chip and peel.

I highly recommend Mauricio and his team from MR Remodeling LLC. They are superheroes in my book, and I cannot thank them enough for turning my nightmare experience into an appreciated and anticipate home update. I will only use Mauricio for future projects. Thank you.
reviews.author: Joleann Beene

reviews.text:
Mauricio is exceptional as a competent contractor who makes certain his clients understand the work to be done including a reasoned time frame with excellent communication. He listens and responds so that agreement is reached as to what’s been said and next steps in the construction process. Finally, I was deeply impressed with his teams daily clean up both inside and outside the home.

Thank you for a job well done😇
reviews.author: Scott Kelly

reviews.text: From the start of our major first floor remodel including kitchen we’ve been so absolutely pleased! Mauricio and his team, which we give high praises to, nailed our project and in a timely manner. Our kitchen, new stairs and living room look like a new house! He even came up with a design to cover & make a white beam across our downstairs look like a wooden beam for this 20’ ceiling. We absolutely recommend him!  And thank you Mauricio!!!!
reviews.author: Jeff Cherry

data.summary: The review profile is highly suspicious. The core issue is that the 5-star reviews for the 'HQ' listing are verbatim copies of the reviews from the 'Local' listing, posted by 'Anonymous' users. This is a classic sign of review duplication/manipulation. The lack of any critical reviews, low total volume, and absence from other platforms further undermines credibility. The reviews themselves are generic and lack the specific details (project costs, timelines, material brands, crew names, before/after specifics) typical of authentic contractor reviews.
fake_signals: Identical reviews posted on two different Google listings
All reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback
Low total review volume for a high average rating
No presence on other major contractor review sites
Reviews are generic and lack specific project details
Reviews posted in a tight timeframe (2-3 years ago)
authentic_signals: Reviews mention a specific owner/manager name (Mauricio)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Extremely high rating (4.85) with very low review volume (9 total) and identical reviews posted across two different Google listings. No presence on other major review platforms (BBB, Angi, Houzz, Yelp) which is unusual for an established contractor.
